images.name: bark
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square seamless base-color texture for bark on independently authored rounded forest game meshes, Quiet Cove xhigh.
Primary request: a flat full-frame 1024 by 1024 hand-painted bark texture. Soft irregular vertical grooves and gently curved bark plates, occasional small oval knots, restrained warm muted taupe brown. Broad simple painterly shapes with subtle fine grain, low contrast, soft matte rounded game art. Uniform ambient color, no baked directional lighting or shadows. Entire image is one continuous bark surface, no tree silhouette, no 3D object, no perspective, no borders, no labels or text or watermark. Tile edges should connect seamlessly. Image will be used as real UV surface texture, so keep detail evenly distributed. Opaque background.

images.name: foliage
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one square seamless diffuse surface texture for rounded tree canopies and forest foliage in Quiet Cove xhigh, a restrained stylized 3D game.
Primary request: a flat all-over pattern of many soft overlapping small rounded leaves. Muted sage and olive green, gently varied tiny leaf shapes and subtle veins. Dense contiguous leaves fill every pixel, no gaps, no branches, no scene or tree silhouette. Broad painterly low-contrast shapes, a soft matte gouache finish, evenly diffuse lighting without baked directional shadows. Full frame orthographic surface pattern, ideally seamless tiling across all edges. 1024 square. No text, no borders, no watermark. Opaque background.

images.name: stone
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one square seamless UV base-color texture for rounded boulders and pebbles in Quiet Cove xhigh.
Primary request: a flat continuous weathered stone surface, restrained pale warm gray with subdued sage mineral flecks, soft broad cloudy mottling, fine subtle pores and a few faint hairline veins. Painterly matte stylized game art, low contrast, no strong black cracks, no separate stones or pebble arrangement. Uniform diffuse illumination, no shadow or highlights baked in. Entire square filled by one surface, no perspective, no recognizable object or scene, no text, border or watermark. 1024 square, seamless edge tiling, opaque.

images.name: wood
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square seamless UV albedo texture, weathered timber used on a small dock, bench and cut logs in Quiet Cove xhigh.
Primary request: a single flat continuous light honey taupe wood surface, long gently wavering vertical grain, a few modest elongated knots, soft brushed pigment marks. Restrained warm muted brown, matte low-contrast painterly game art. No plank borders, no nails, no perspective or object, no cast shadows or baked lighting. Fill the entire 1024 square image with the continuous material, naturally repeating edge to edge. No text, border or watermark. Opaque.

images.name: caustics
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: grayscale seamless water-caustics intensity mask for an animated shallow-sea material in Quiet Cove xhigh.
Primary request: flat square monochrome texture of underwater sunlight caustics. A delicate irregular continuous network of thin softly luminous white curved lines making organic roughly rounded cells, brighter at occasional junctions, over an almost black background. Natural varied cell sizes, elegant wavy flowing edges, no hexagon grid. Dense enough to show many cells, approximately twenty cells across. Crisp white centers with narrow soft gray glow. Uniform distribution, tile seamlessly along all image edges. No water scene, perspective, sand, rocks or objects. No text, labels, border, watermark. Opaque grayscale image, 1024 square.
